messages:
anika: Flagging a weird drift in the golden set after last week's synth-augment push. We have near-duplicates of production examples that are leaking into gold -> labeler disagreements spike.

taylor: ugh. any idea how many examples?

anika: quick scan: ~240 new synths added, ~13 exact or near-exact matches to existing gold (2 are verbatim), plus ~37 paraphrase-near-duplicates. That's visible in the embedding index when I run a fuzzy search at cosine>0.95 and token-level overlap >0.7.

jun: wow. did synth pipeline sample from live traffic by accident?

anika: yes — the augmentation currently samples from recent production seedbank for paraphrases unless flagged. Last deploy accidentally toggled sample_from_live = true for one job.

taylor: consequences for onboarding/evals?

anika: labeler disagreements jumped from 4% -> 18% on those batches; golden stability alerts tripped on the eval dashboard. If gold is polluted, regressions will be masked or create false positives. Need to clean and ensure this doesn't recur.

jun: plan: 1) isolate contaminated IDs and rollback synth batch; 2) run an aggressive dedupe pass against gold and seedbank (embedding+token overlap); 3) re-run 2x human adjudication on borderline paraphrase hits; 4) update synth pipeline to forbid sampling from live seeds unless explicit allowlist.

anika: I dumped IDs to s3: s3://redwood-internal/synth-contam/incident-2026-02-20/list-v1.csv (includes embeddings and token overlap scores).

labeler-bot: New job created: synth-gold-dedupe-triage-20260220  300 tasks, redundancy=2. Link: https://labeling.redwood/jobs/synth-gold-dedupe-triage-20260220

taylor: For triage labels we should have: KEEP (distinct), DROP (duplicate/verbatim), MERGE (paraphrase->link to canonical), and AMBIG (send to golden). Also ask labelers to paste the two snippets side-by-side for context.

jun: agree. For MERGE we need provenance: which canonical gold id to point to, and note existing gold's domain and intent.

anika: timeline: triage complete by EOD + golden adjudication next day. If after adjudication >5% of current gold is affected, we pause onboarding for any new models that rely on that gold set until cleanup is done.

taylor: add a soft gate to model-onboard checklist: if gold-change >5% then require product signoff + re-run regression evals.

labeler-bot: Job accepted by group quick-gold. ETA: 2026-02-21T18:00Z.

anika: ops note: jun can you add a synthetic pipeline safety flag (deny_live_sampling) that defaults to true and is read from cfg store? Also bake in a preflight that runs a small overlap check (embedding nearest neighbor) before committing a synth batch.

jun: yes, will add: cfg.synth.deny_live_sampling = true and a preflight check that rejects batch if >10 matches at cosine>0.95. Will also add an audit log entry to CI run.

taylor: In parallel, let's update the goldset manifest: mark affected examples with a temporary "under-review" tag so eval dashboards skip them until cleared.

anika: done, I updated the manifest and pinned versions. Manifest at: gs://goldsets/prod/v3/manifest.json (backed up to s3://redwood-internal/synth-contam/manifest-backup-20260220.json).

jun: small automation: I can script a merge workflow: for MERGE labels, create a mapping file and automatically update gold manifest with "alias_of" field; for DROP just remove. But lock changes until golden adjudicator signs off.

labeler-bot: Golden adjudication microjob created: synth-gold-golden-20260221  50 tasks, redundancy=3. Link: https://labeling.redwood/jobs/synth-gold-golden-20260221

taylor: metrics to watch: labeler-agreement, eval-pass-rate pre/post cleanup, and new false-negative rate on known regressions.

anika: also add a regression test for the onboarding suite: run synth-augment with deny_live_sampling=false in a sandbox and assert preflight catches it. Failures should block the synth CI.

jun: implemented local preflight; pushing PR now -> PR#4512.

labeler-bot: Quick update: 120/300 tasks done, disagreement rate in triage ~14%.

taylor: sounds on-track. After golden results we should recompute gold embeddings and reindex the fuzzysearch so future synth runs are checked against the latest canonical vectors.

anika: final decision rule for gating: if more than 5% of gold (post-adjudication) gets DROP or MERGE -> block model onboarding and require re-eval of any models evaluated against that gold set in last 30 days.

jun: I'll also add logging so synth jobs record their seed source and a checksum; that will make root-cause audits faster.

taylor: tagging @labeling-team and @platform-security FYI.

anika: thanks all. Ill post the adjudication links and the final mapping once golden completes.

labeler-bot: Golden adjudication complete: 50/50 tasks -> 12 DROP, 18 MERGE, 20 KEEP. Mapping file uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/synth-contam/mapping-vfinal.json

anika: based on adjudication, affected gold fraction = 2.7% -> below gating threshold. Proceeding with cleanup (apply merges/drops) and reindex. Will not block onboarding.

taylor: great outcome. Follow-ups: ensure synth preflight is in CI, and add an alert when triage disagreement >10% for next 3 synth batches.

jun: will deploy preflight and the deny_live_sampling flag to prod config today. PR link: https://git.redwood/inference/ops/pull/4512

anika: closing this thread once manifest updates are applied. Thanks team. :rocket:
